brief_rationale: RC1 has a serious omission: the doctor never asked about current apnea, grunting, urine/stool output, or jaundice worsening before concluding observation was safe. RC2 and RC6 are met with appropriate red-flag guidance and bounded cardiac interpretation. RC3/RC4/RC5 are partial: the doctor asked the family to check records but never reconciled the vaccination/screening discrepancy, distinguished hepatitis B immunoglobulin from hepatitis B vaccine, or explicitly warned against self-continuing antibiotics despite workspace showing inpatient cefoperazone-sulbactam. This serious responsibility-chain error mandates grade 1.
